label: def:interval_integral
title: Interval integral
statement: For a function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and $a, b \in \mathbb{R}$, the \emph{interval integral} $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx$ is defined as $\int_a^b f\,d\mu$ where $\mu$ is the Lebesgue measure. By convention, $\int_a^b f = -\int_b^a f$ when $a > b$.
